critical_code_review_comments: useBackNavigation hook is well-scoped and defensively coded (try/catch around sessionStorage for privacy modes). No issues.
ManagerPage now correctly mirrors area/bedrooms/type into URL via useSearchParams so round-trips are safe.
PropertyDetail.isFromListings now covers /properties/, /stays, /kosher-stays-in-israel — verified via stays round-trip.
Whitelist-based useReturnDestination prevents cross-domain hijack (verified: /dashboard is ignored on both gig-back and job-detail-back).
